name: Get-Printer
title: Inspect installed Windows printers
summary: Lists installed printers, drivers, ports, sharing state, and default status.

examples.command: Get-Printer | Select-Object Name, DriverName, PortName, PrinterStatus, Shared
examples.description: Shows a concise printer inventory without changing configuration.

permissions.notes: Local printer inventory is normally visible without elevation.

risk.warning: Printer and server names may be organization-specific; review before sharing.

output_fields.name: PortName
output_fields.description: Connection or port used by the printer.

common_errors.message: The specified server does not exist
common_errors.meaning: A requested print server is unavailable or its name is incorrect.
